nick-somers.text: "I believe our city deserves thoughtful leadership, responsible growth, and a City Hall that listens." His site lists no detailed issue positions.

laurene-weste.text: Campaign site says she expanded protected open space to 16,000 acres linked by a 150-mile trail system, and lists as a priority an open-space green belt surrounding the City.

source.title: Laurene Weste for City Council (campaign site)

laurene-weste.text: Says she has grown the City's budget reserves to $27 million and delivered a balanced, on-time city budget every year.

laurene-weste.text: "Advocated for veterans' and senior housing" and pledges to continue doing so.

laurene-weste.text: Says she led opposition to a poorly sited State courthouse proposed near McBean Parkway and helped defeat the LA County prison proposed for Saugus.
